platinum_estimate_note: About 200 hours per KeenGamer; PushSquare estimates 300+ hours. Difficulty 4/10. No online trophies, one playthrough is enough, free roam after the story, no mission replay, 15 manual save slots, cheats disable trophies, no New Game+.

roadmap.title: Story first — Chapters 1 to 4, 60–80 hours
roadmap.detail: Play the campaign at your own pace and enjoy it. Story trophies pop as you go. The one thing you must not miss: the balcony meditation with Lucia on the morning after the mission 'Down to Earth', before you leave Chapter 1 — it is the only missable trophy in the game (Positive Mental Attitude), and there is no mission replay. Keep a manual save before that morning.

roadmap.title: 100% Completion and the big counts — about 100 hours
roadmap.detail: After the final mission the 100% Completion checklist unlocks (Touch Pad > Progress > 100% Completion). Work through it: 39 Gang Operations, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loan Jobs, 8 bank vault robberies, 100 optional tasks, 15 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 Cocaine Flamingos, 42 Drone Time Trials, 70 of 80 Challenges and 250 stunts. Most of the grind trophies fall here.

roadmap.title: Strangers & Freaks and the leftovers — 10–20 hours
roadmap.detail: Finish the 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and three more), hunt the unique animal for Bret, and mop up the last odd trophies — the partnership, choice and exploration ones. The Platinum pops when the 54th other trophy does.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: There is no separate task here: this pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. Treat it as the finish line of the roadmap — story first, then the 100% Completion cleanup, then the stranger strands and the last stragglers. Budget roughly 200 hours (KeenGamer) to 300+ (PushSquare) for the whole run.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies
This one pops automatically when the last of them lands
